# Concrete range-finish timeout

The first actual phase did **not** establish the intended negative. Source admission passed for 9 selected modules from 11 supplied source files and 15 total inputs. Verification then exited 4 with `LLS8002`: the target Lean module `ObjectConcreteRangeFinish` exceeded the unchanged 300,000 ms child limit, observed at 300,013 ms. The complete verify command took 425,362 ms. No artifact was produced; the positive phase is **NOT_RUN**.

The negative still contains only the expected wire statistic 184→185 change and ends in the actual emitted `rfl` proof. This timeout is a resource-limited proof failure, not a demonstrated mismatch, false positive theorem or compiler admission failure. Independent review confirmed all source, development-lock, tool, epoch, idle, zero-memory-event and storage postconditions. A successful launcher or those postconditions do not accept the proof.

[results.json](results.json) binds the exact frozen sources, raw receipts, failure review, genuine development lock and retained failed emission. All original raw evidence remains local. The failed emitted Lean source is not a verified artifact. Original preparation-time NOT_RUN files remain unchanged.

The [source investigation](evidence/concrete-finish-timeout-investigation.json) identifies a single exact production version-result hole and proposes the supported Nat/Induction/Cases/Congruence transport using the already accepted version theorem, followed by the mandatory actual finish consumer. The full positive and false-wire statements remain unchanged. The whole-expression normalization hypothesis is not a measured subterm bottleneck, and no avoidance, cost or success guarantee is made. The successor source design has independent SPEC approval, with exact authority pins in results.json. No repair candidate or retry has run.

Concrete finish, its successful admitted-range composition, whole-data hash and comparison, the original Read33 controls and complete PrismPM integration remain open. The earlier admitted-range proposal is explicitly conditional on finish acceptance, which has not happened.
